title: 第8章 复制灵米
content_zh:
“小娃子，你瞧着我像是没事吗？”

    李老道横着眼嗤笑一声，枯瘦的手指死死抓住韩榆手腕，抓的他生疼：“原来，这也是仙师……这也是仙师……哈哈，亏我还以为他们有什么了不起！”

    “我为了学他们，连炼血功都停了！”

    “看来，我并不用停炼血功，都一样啊——噗！”

    说到这里，李老道凹陷的丑脸上满是幻想破灭的惨笑。

    大约是情绪太激动，甚至还吐出了一口血。

    韩榆搀扶着他回到他自己石屋，又把他的种子给背过来。

    李老道躺在床上看他忙前忙后，眼神渐渐柔和。

    这小娃儿一点都不像他爷爷，心地善良更像婉儿。

    “小娃儿，你为什么照顾我？我昨天还要打你，忘了吗？”

    韩榆想了想，回答：“道爷你一路上说着对我不客气，其实并没有真的害我。如果是真的要抢东西，像是里长、王管事那样，其实也不会跟我说这么多话的。”

    李老道释然一笑，浑浊老眼带着柔光，声音依旧嘶哑：“你倒是不傻。”

    下午，王管事又来了，给了韩榆、李老道一人一百斤糙米，一句解释的话都没有便转身离去。

    李老道和韩榆两人也不用他解释，便明白，这一百斤糙米想来就是要换取他们一年两季、一成收获的所有代价。

    以王管事的蛮横霸道，指望他第二次给送吃食显然是绝无可能的。

    当天晚上，孙康给李老道、韩榆分别送来五十斤大米，得知今天李老道触怒王管事被打伤的事情后，也不由叹了一口气：“王管事本来就是在咱们灵田处说一不二，对孙兰这样有希望成为外门弟子的态度还好一些，对没有希望的，向来盘剥厉害。”

    “一斤青禾灵米在万春谷内可换两百斤凡米，若是出了万春谷，落到凡俗的达官贵人手中，则是能换数百斤、甚至千斤凡米也不止，换糙米当然更多。”

    “王管事用这一百斤糙米，要换你们两人一成收获，那可真是……”

    孙康说到这里，也有点怕隔墙有耳，住口不言。

    李老道见他是个厚道人，真的送来食物，比口惠实不至的张山更信得过，也比那个小丫头刘兰沉稳可靠，便郑重道谢，有心结好。

    韩榆也跟着道谢，又问孙康：“孙师兄，青禾米是干什么用的？跟凡米不一样？”

    “当然不一样！”

    孙康笑道：“凡米顶多填饱肚子罢了，青禾灵米内蕴含灵气，有助于咱们修炼，若是日日能吃灵米，咱们修炼速度可就快多了！”

    李老道慨然：“有姓王的在，我们什么时候才能吃得上灵米！”
content_en:
"Little kid, do you look at me like I'm okay?"

Li Laodao sneered with his eyes crossed, and grabbed Han Yu's wrist with his skinny fingers, causing him pain: "So, this is also an immortal master... This is also an immortal master... Haha, I thought they were so great!"

"In order to learn from them, I even stopped practicing blood kung fu!"

"It seems that I don't have to stop practicing the Blood Kung Fu, it's still the same - poof!"

At this point, Li Laodao's sunken ugly face was filled with a sad smile of disillusionment.

He was probably so excited that he even vomited a mouthful of blood.

Han Yu helped him back to his own stone house and carried his seed on his back.

Li Laodao lay on the bed and watched him busy, his eyes gradually softened.

This little kid is nothing like his grandpa. He is kind-hearted and more like Wan'er.

"Little baby, why are you taking care of me? I beat you yesterday, have you forgotten?"

Han Yu thought for a while and replied: "Master Dao, you said you were rude to me along the way, but in fact you didn't really hurt me. If you really wanted to rob something, like the mayor and manager Wang, you wouldn't have said so many words to me."

Li Laodao smiled with relief, his cloudy old eyes were filled with soft light, and his voice was still hoarse: "You are not stupid."

In the afternoon, Manager Wang came again and gave Han Yu and Li Laodao one hundred catties of brown rice each, then turned and left without a word of explanation.

Li Laodao and Han Yu didn't need him to explain. They understood that these one hundred kilograms of brown rice were intended to be exchanged for their two crops a year and 10% of the harvest.

Given the arrogance and tyranny of Manager Wang, it was obviously impossible to expect him to deliver food for the second time.

That night, Sun Kang sent 50 kilograms of rice to Li Laodao and Han Yu each. After learning that Li Laodao had offended Manager Wang and was injured today, he couldn't help but sigh: "Manager Wang has been telling the truth in our spiritual field. He has a better attitude towards Sun Lan who has the hope of becoming an outer disciple. He has always exploited those who have no hope."

"One pound of green rice can be exchanged for two hundred pounds of ordinary rice in the Wanchun Valley. If it leaves the Wanchun Valley and falls into the hands of ordinary dignitaries, it can be exchanged for hundreds or even a thousand pounds of ordinary rice. Of course, it can be exchanged for more brown rice."

"Manager Wang uses these one hundred kilograms of brown rice to exchange for 10% of the harvest for the two of you. That's really..."

When Sun Kang said this, he was a little afraid that the walls had ears, so he kept silent.

Li Laodao saw that he was a kind person and really sent food. He was more trustworthy than Zhang Shan, who never paid what he said, and he was calmer and more reliable than that little girl Liu Lan, so he solemnly thanked him and made a good relationship.

Han Yu also thanked him and asked Sun Kang: "Senior Brother Sun, what is Qinghe rice used for? Is it different from ordinary rice?"

"Of course it's different!"

Sun Kang said with a smile: "Ordinary rice can only fill our stomachs at most. Qinghe spiritual rice contains spiritual energy, which is helpful for our cultivation. If we can eat spiritual rice every day, our cultivation speed will be much faster!"

Li Laodao said with emotion: "With a man named Wang here, when will we be able to eat spiritual rice!"
